tail:
Completed batch 6: authored the nine A-page items, three B-page examples, both draft pages, and the batch evidence. The manifest preserves the current plan’s five A-page prerequisites; the older design reservation conflict is documented in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-6.notes.md).

Scoped checks pass: proof layout reports 12 items, 32 steps, and zero defects; precheck has zero failures; the strict proof contract passes all 12 items; content policy, dependency-cycle checks, rendering, coverage, and all three source fetches pass. The [coverage record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-6.coverage.json) records 20 harvested results from full-text treatments by [Reall](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/hsr1000/part3_gr_lectures.pdf), [Friedrich–Rendall](https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/0002074), and [Alcubierre et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0907.1151).

All 12 readiness records are **escalated**, not ready. The root original for `lem-linear-matrix-odes-have-unique-global-solutions-on-a-given-interval` changed after its read-only physics import was created; `physics-check` reports that import as stale. The item lies in every assigned item’s transitive dependency closure. Owner reconciliation is required before readiness can be marked ready. Whole-run dependency checks also encounter invalid or empty inventories in other batches; the scoped batch-6 dependency levels pass.

The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/einstein-maxwell-models-mathematics/emg-cp01.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/einstein-maxwell-models-mathematics/emg-cp01-examples.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-6.pages.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-6.proof-contracts.json) are ready for review.
